Dear Sir/Madam, 
 
Subject: Post Earnings Call 
This is further to our letters dated August 4, 2026 and August 12, 2026, on the captioned subject.  
Pursuant to Regulation 30 of the SEBI (Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015, the 
audio recording of the Post Earnings (Conference) Call (Group Call) held today, i.e. Thursday, August 13, 2026, 
has been uploaded on the website of the Company, under the tab “Investor Relations > Disclosures under SEBI

https://www.bata.in/disclosures-sebi.html > For latest Stock Exchange disclosures > Click here
